ShortDescription.Value: Warns about blocked trains and marks where the game despawns stuck trains, so you can fix the rail layout.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Bottlenecks
Cities: Skylines II silently despawns trains that end up in a deadlock (trains blocking each other). There is no warning, so it is hard to find the rail layout problem. Bottlenecks shows where it happens so you can fix the layout.
## Features (v1)
- Orange train icon above a train that has been held at a signal, junction or crossing at very low speed for about 45 seconds of game time. Not shown while boarding at a station or when just following another train. Disappears when the train moves again. - Red train icon at the spot where the game despawned a stuck train. Stays for a few minutes so you can find the pinch point. - Hold deadlocked trains (on by default): trains that end up in a deadlock are frozen in place with a red icon instead of being silently despawned, so you can see and fix the rail layout. Remove them yourself or fix the layout to free them. - Optional pause: automatically pause the game when a new train deadlock is detected. - Notification cards: a notification appears when a train deadlock is detected; click it to move the camera there.
## Notes
- By default the mod prevents deadlocked trains from being despawned (they are held in place). This can be turned off in Options. - The mod otherwise only observes and shows icons. - Icons from a previous session are cleaned up when a save is loaded. - Safe to remove: the icons are inert without the mod.
## Planned
- Settings for timings. - More vehicle types (later).
